.github/workflows/CI.yml.summary: This file defines a GitHub Actions workflow for building Docker images and performing security scans using Trivy on push and pull request events.

.github/workflows/snyk.yml.summary: This file sets up a GitHub Actions workflow to scan Dockerfiles for vulnerabilities using Snyk on push, pull request, and manual trigger events.

.gitlab-ci.yml.summary: This file configures a GitLab CI pipeline that includes templates for AI documentation and a GitHub mirror.

catalog-info.yaml.summary: This file contains metadata for the CapsuleBay component, describing its purpose and providing links and annotations for Backstage integration.

infra/docker-compose.yml.summary: This file defines a Docker Compose configuration for setting up services like Vault, a Docker registry, and a UI for managing the registry.

infra/setup.sh.summary: This script automates the setup of the CapsuleBay infrastructure, including creating necessary directories, configuring Vault, and launching Docker services.

mkdocs.yml.summary: Configures the documentation site for CapsuleBay, detailing its structure and navigation.

n8n/docker-compose.yml.summary: Defines the Docker setup for the n8n workflow automation tool, including environment variables and port mappings.

portainer/docker-compose.yml.summary: Sets up the Portainer container management interface with specified ports and volume mappings.

whoami/docker-compose.yml.summary: Configures the whoami service, a simple HTTP server for testing, with port and environment settings.
